text:
olivia: Deploybot flagged eu-canary p95 increase after v3.6.1 rollout. Deploybot suggests autorevert. Anyone on call?

deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT SUGGESTED — metric: p95_latency_eu > 900ms (now=1100ms). Will autorevert in 5m unless an operator overrides with `override:manual`.

matt: I'm seeing repeated kvcache timeouts in the eu pool logs but errors aren't across all nodes. prefer scoped manual rollback to avoid stomping na.

leah: +1 to manual. If we can limit to eu-canary + eu-prod slice that would be ideal. Jordan, can you run partial rollback playbook?

jordan: on it. Opening rollback ticket and checklist now. quick plan: 1) pin eu route to v3.6.0, 2) run regional rollback, 3) purge kvcache prefix for canary, 4) hold release notes update until stability confirmed.

olivia: @sophia-support can you prepare a short customer-facing blurb we can send if support sees noise? no promises, just FYI language.

sophia-support: Draft: "We observed increased latency in our EU region after a recent update. We've rolled back that change for EU to restore normal performance. No action required from customers; services are stable. We'll follow up if anything else is needed." happy to shorten. :+1:

oncall-bot: Canary rollback requires operator auth. @ops-lead please approve manual override within 3m or deploy-bot will autorevert.

ops-lead: Approved. Manual rollback authorized. Jordan proceed and tag me when complete.

jordan: Starting rollback now. commands: 
```
./release rollback --region eu --to v3.6.0 --scope canary,prod-eu
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-eu --to-revision=v3.6.0
# purge kvcache prefix for canary
./infra/kvcachectl purge --prefix canary-eu --confirm
```

deploy-bot: rollback job started (job_id=rb-20231105-773). Estimated completion ~3m. streaming logs -> `rolling back 3/5 shards...`

leah: watching SLO dashboard. if p95 drops < 450ms and error_rate stable for 10m we unpin.

matt: quick sanity check: post-rollback smoke command: `curl -sS -H "x-rw-region: eu" https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq .latency_p95`

deploy-bot: rollback completed (job_id=rb-20231105-773). post-check: p95_eu=410ms, error_rate=0.21%.

jordan: Done. Ticket #RB-4857. Pin in place for 2h per ops request. I'll open follow-up to reattempt v3.6.1 after kvcache fix and expanded canary test.

olivia: I'll send the customer note and update the release tracker + release-notes draft. matt, leah — please add any postmortem bullets about kvcache prefix handling.

matt: adding: "cause likely kvcache eviction/timeout under new sharding; mitigate by hotter-prefix throttling in canary + monitoring for large-prefix ops."

leah: please add a canary test that scans for large prefix latencies before rollout.

ops-lead: thanks team. keep the pin until we have a clear repro + test. ping me before unpin. :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks everyone — good catch. will follow up with a short postmortem and next steps.
